column1: Purpose: Log how much proof you add each day across all nine proof types.
1. Fill in the Date for each day.
2. Fill in how many Logos, Video Testimonials, Written Testimonials, Screenshots, and Case Studies you added that day.
3. Fill in how many Proof Of Work pieces, Speaking At Events pieces, PR Articles, and 3rd-Party Reviews you added that day.
5. Add a note if anything worth flagging happened.
